xsmall.$description: 12px — same primitive step text.caption's own composite token uses. Text's `size` prop, added Phase 5 Chunk 04 follow-up: a standalone font-size override independent of `variant`, resolved the same way `weight` overrides variant's own font-weight (later in cascade source order — see TOKEN_TEXT_PROPS in atomicConfig.mjs).

small.$description: 14px — same primitive step text.body-sm's own composite token uses.

medium.$description: 16px — same primitive step text.body-md's own composite token uses. Text's own default size, matching variant="body"'s default when size is left unset.

large.$description: 18px — same primitive step text.heading-sm's own composite token uses. Lets running text read as large as a small heading without becoming one semantically.

xlarge.$description: 20px — same primitive step text.heading-md's own composite token uses.

2xlarge.$description: 24px — same primitive step text.heading-lg's own composite token uses. Deliberately stops here, not at fontSize.800/900 (30px/36px) — those two stay heading/display-exclusive territory; see decisions/decision-text-size-prop.md.

display.$description: letterSpacing here is Latin-script tuning, not for Devanagari content. Note for Phase 5: Style Dictionary's CSS output serializes this token via the CSS `font` shorthand, which cannot carry letter-spacing at all (a CSS limitation, not ours) — so `font: var(--ds-text-display)` alone applies weight/size/line-height/family but never letter-spacing. That's convenient here: Devanagari content should consume just the shorthand, while Latin-specific components opt in separately with `letter-spacing: var(--ds-letter-spacing-tight)`.
